scope: Local dependency-aware candidate reads only; no live tests, deployment or game effects

checks.name: Release app and three Worker dry builds
Skill, changed prose, strict future, repository consistency and whitespace

acceptance_evidence: Sixteen neutral pages agree across C#, TypeScript and actual synthetic Workspace/MCP reads, preserving document order and complete combined-filter counts.

All explicit dependency states are checked in the full validated document before metadata/date/text filters and pagination; completed archived records satisfy dependency completion while archived incomplete/cancelled/paused/waiting/someday/active records do not.
Only nonarchived active Todos qualify; parent links do not imply dependency inheritance and game mapping does not imply gameplay permission.
Native restore blocks a dependant while exposing the restored Todo as active work; recompletion restores dependant eligibility without scoring dependants.
Current D1 reads reject stale revisions, malformed source/graph and changed access epochs. MCP unavailable reads invent neither empty tasks nor mutation uncertainty.
Public/private read grants and profile isolation hold; warmed reads create zero commands, preparations or upstream writes.
limitations: Saved views, review/reminder policies, automatic ranking, production controls and live qualification remain separate.
repairs: The initial archived completed-dependency fixture omitted a required completion event. An explicit retained archived completion now makes the fixture valid.
A candidate-count expectation omitted the newly active dependency. Assertions now verify dependant exclusion, restored-parent inclusion and the resulting unchanged count.
